description.summary: Fast, scalable, distributed revision control system
description.p: Git is popular version control system designed to handle very large projects with speed and efficiency; it is used for many high profile open source projects, most notably the Linux kernel.

Git falls in the category of distributed source code management tools. Every Git working directory is a full-fledged repository with full revision tracking capabilities, not dependent on network access or a central server.
This package provides the git main components. It is built without curl and cannot fetch from or push to http and https remotes.
